bias.en: Short-term bearish · $1,465–1,475 floor held on the close
bias.zh: 短线偏空 · $1,465–1,475 底部收盘守住

read.en: Sandisk slipped 0.3% on Oct 13 to $1,482.33 after a deep intraday drop to $1,403.16. It is below its 5-day ($1,571), 10-day ($1,647), 100-day ($1,649) and 30-day ($1,671) averages, and above the 200-day ($1,194). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,812), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月13日盘中大幅下探至 $1,403.16，收盘小跌 0.3% 至 $1,482.33。股价位于 5 日（$1,571）、10 日（$1,647）、100 日（$1,649）和 30 日均线（$1,671）下方，并在 200 日均线（$1,194）上方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看空（$1,812），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The $1,465–1,475 floor, held since June, was broken intraday and the low briefly undercut the Aug 24 low ($1,417), but the close was back above the floor. Resistance is $1,504 (Sep 16 low), then $1,571 (5-day average) and $1,647–1,671 (10, 100 and 30-day averages). A close below $1,465 would open $1,403, then $1,325.
read.zh: 6月以来守住的 $1,465–1,475 底部盘中被跌破，低点一度跌破 8月24日低点（$1,417），但收盘重回底部上方。阻力为 $1,504（9月16日低点），其次 $1,571（5 日均线）及 $1,647–1,671（10 日、100 日和 30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $1,465，下一目标看 $1,403，再看 $1,325。
